# U51: Each Workspace section opens at its own address, from the menu on a computer and the list on a phone; someone who isn’t an admin sees About, Cycles and Privacy read-only and their own removals, and old links still land, the inbox’s at Feedback

- **Belongs to:** the Feedback module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `WORKSPACE-SECTIONS`
- **Budget:** at most 14 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `logged` ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Grace, at `/workspace` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U51

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Grace (`grace`).
- Go to `/workspace` in the demo.
- _Note:_ A side menu on a computer, About beside it; on a phone About, then the other sections as a list (WR2).
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `JSON.stringify(labels) === JSON.stringify(want(SECTIONS.map(([, l]) => l)))`, where `const SECTIONS = [['overview', 'About'], ['cycles', 'Cycles'], ['access', 'Access'], ['features', 'Features'], ['privacy', 'Privacy'], ['removed', 'Recently removed']]`; `const phone = device === 'phone'`; `const menu = phone ? p.getByRole('list', { name: 'Workspace sections' }) : p.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Workspace sections' })`; `const labels = (await menu.getByRole('link').allInnerTexts()).map((x) => x.split(/\n| · /)[0].trim())`; `const want = (ls) => (phone ? ls.filter((l) => l !== 'About') : ls)`. Else it says: an admin’s sections are {labels.join(', ')}.
- _Note:_ A long workspace name wraps to two lines in the sidebar, then ends with … and the full name on hover.
- If `!phone`:
  - **Check:** (`attention`) met when `nm.lines === 2 && nm.clipped && nm.hover.length > 0`, where `const nm = await p.evaluate(() => { const n = document.querySelector('.side .ws-name'); const lh = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(n).lineHeight); return { lines: Math.round(n.getBoundingClientRect().height / lh), clipped: n.scrollHeight > n.clientHeight + 1, hover: n.closest('[title]')?.getAttribute('title') || '' }; })`. Else it says: a long workspace name shows on {nm.lines} lines (clipped {nm.clipped}, hover “{nm.hover}”).
  - Reload the page.
- **Check:** (`progress`) met when `phone ? await p.locator('.ws-menu').count() === 0 && await p.locator('.ws-facts').isVisible() : await p.locator('.ws-facts').isVisible()`, where `const phone = device === 'phone'`. Else it says: {worked out in the journey as `phone ? 'a phone shows the side menu, or not About above the list' : 'a computer does not show About beside the menu'`}.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “sections”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ Into a section and back, from the menu or the list: its address, its heading, and (on a phone) the way back.
- **Step.** Press the “Cycles” link.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/workspace/cycles”.
- **Check:** The cycles block (`.cycles-block`) shows.
- **Check:** (`entry`) met when `heading === 'Cycles'`, where `const phone = device === 'phone'`; `const heading = phone ? await p.locator('.page-head h1').innerText() : await p.locator('.ws-body h2').first().innerText()`. Else it says: Cycles opened with the heading “{heading}”.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “cycles”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- If `phone`:
  - **Step.** Press the “Workspace” link.
- Otherwise:
  - **Check:** (`attention`) met when `await menu.getByRole('link', { name: /^Cycles/ }).getAttribute('aria-current') === 'page'`, where `const phone = device === 'phone'`; `const menu = phone ? p.getByRole('list', { name: 'Workspace sections' }) : p.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Workspace sections' })`. Else it says: the menu does not mark the section that’s open.
- _Note:_ Every address opens its own section, with one main action at most.
- For each of `SECTIONS`, 6 rows:
  - _Row:_ “overview”, “About”
  - _Row:_ “cycles”, “Cycles”
  - _Row:_ “access”, “Access”
  - _Row:_ “features”, “Features”
  - _Row:_ “privacy”, “Privacy”
  - _Row:_ “removed”, “Recently removed”
  - Go to `/workspace/{id}` in the demo.
  - **Check:** The page’s heading area shows.
  - _Note:_ About is Workspace's own page: on a phone its heading is Workspace's, on a computer "About this workspace".
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `!broken.length`, where `const broken = []`. Else it says: sections that don’t open as themselves: {broken.join('; ')}.
- _Note:_ Old links: the inbox's from a GitHub issue, and the one-page Workspace's anchors.
- Go to `/workspace?inbox=1&markup=mk_old` in the demo.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/feedback?markup=mk_old”.
- Go to `/workspace#people` in the demo.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/people” in the demo.
- **Check:** (`errors`) met when `toInbox && toPeople`, where `const toInbox = await p.waitForURL(/\/feedback\?markup=mk_old/, { timeout: 5000 }).then(() => true, () => false)`; `const toPeople = await p.waitForURL(/\/demo\/people(\?|$)/, { timeout: 5000 }).then(() => true, () => false)`. Else it says: old links: the inbox’s {toInbox}, #people {toPeople}.
- _Note:_ Someone who isn't an admin: About, Cycles, Privacy and Recently removed, and an admins' section says whose it is.
- Switch to Oskar in the Demo panel (the quiet Demo button): a role card’s person, or anyone else by typing their name.
- Go to `/workspace` in the demo.
- Go to `/workspace/access` in the demo.
- **Check:** “Access is for admins. The admins here are Amara Nwosu, Grace Achterberg and Hamid Rezaei.” is shown.
- _Note:_ Privacy reads for everyone, what the app records about them; only admins have its switch (re-review, 8 Nov, backlog T).
- Go to `/workspace/privacy` in the demo.
- **Check:** “Admins change it” is shown.
- _Note:_ Cycles reads for everyone, with nothing to delete; Recently removed lists only what they removed (8 Nov).
- Go to `/workspace/cycles` in the demo.
- Go to `/workspace/removed` in the demo.
- **Check:** “Admins see everyone’s.” is shown.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `JSON.stringify(theirs) === JSON.stringify(want(['About', 'Cycles', 'Privacy', 'Recently removed'])) && told && reads && noSwitch && cyclesRead && ownOnly && await p.getByRole('button', { name: 'Make an MCP token' }).count() === 0`, where `const phone = device === 'phone'`; `const menu = phone ? p.getByRole('list', { name: 'Workspace sections' }) : p.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Workspace sections' })`; `const want = (ls) => (phone ? ls.filter((l) => l !== 'About') : ls)`; `const theirs = (await menu.getByRole('link').allInnerTexts()).map((x) => x.split(/\n| · /)[0].trim())`; `const told = await see(p, 'Access is for admins. The admins here are Amara Nwosu, Grace Achterberg and Hamid Rezaei.').then(() => true, () => false)`; `const reads = await see(p, 'Admins change it').then(() => true, () => false)`; `const noSwitch = await p.getByRole('checkbox', { name: /Record how the app is used/ }).count() === 0`; `const cyclesRead = await see(p, 'Admins start the next cycle and delete an empty one.').then(() => true, () => false) && await p.getByRole('button', { name: /^Delete the cycle/ }).count() === 0`; `const ownOnly = await see(p, 'Admins see everyone’s.').then(() => true, () => false)`. Else it says: someone who isn’t an admin sees {theirs.join(', ')}; told Access is for admins {told}; Privacy read-only {reads && noSwitch}; Cycles read-only {cyclesRead}; Recently removed their own {ownOnly}.
- Close this browser.
